usage: The word '背肌' (bui3 gei1) functions as a noun and refers specifically to the muscles at the back of the body.
It can be used to talk about exercising, strengthening, or injuring the back muscles.
'背肌' often appears in sentences about fitness, sports, or health-related topics.
When describing actions related to '背肌', verbs like 'strengthen', 'train', or 'stretch' are commonly used.
It can be combined with adjectives or verbs to describe the condition or activity involving the back muscles.
